sources.scope: Direct-dependency-wins and resolved graph in project.assets.json
sources.conclusion: A nearer direct reference can replace a transitive version; a pinned transitive edge is insufficient as the sole NativeWeave compatibility check.
Treat inconsistent owned-package closure as a hard post-restore error independent of warning suppression.

sources.scope: Push single package, existing ID/version rejection, registry-specific behavior
sources.conclusion: Nuget.org rejects a published ID/version with409. Multi-package publication is an application-level sequence with partial failure, inferred from the per-package API; no atomic bundle transaction is documented.

sources.scope: Repository signing identities and re-signing after certificate revocation
sources.conclusion: Validate permitted signatures and payload identity; retain upload and downloaded archive digests separately because the signature envelope can change.

sources.scope: Unlisted known-version restore and exceptional deletion
sources.conclusion: Unlist does not revoke an installed/cached or exact-version dependency; do not use it as rollback or kill-switch semantics.
